authority: Central review and mainline-continuation policy for EconMind World V2
constitutional_precedence: requirements.docx and the Constitution remain controlling. This policy may accelerate review timing only; it cannot weaken a P0/P1 invariant or authorize production mutation.
classification_rule: Classify the actual change by its highest affected boundary. Labels, work-package names, file locations, and an owner request cannot lower the effective risk. Uncertainty resolves upward and P0 is never fast-trackable.

P0.label: HIGH_RISK
P0.mainline_rule: All mandatory automated evidence must pass, then an independent reviewer must approve the immutable candidate before VERIFIED, merge, or dependent implementation.

P1.label: NORMAL_MAINLINE_IMPLEMENTATION
P1.mainline_rule: May proceed after all mandatory automated tests, invariants, security checks, and governance checks pass. Independent review may be deferred only to the named Work Package gate.

P2.label: FOUNDATION_DOCS_TOOLING_NON_AUTHORITATIVE_INTEGRATION
P2.mainline_rule: May be owner-fast-tracked after required evidence passes and the record confirms that no P0 boundary changed.

P3.label: NON_BEHAVIOURAL
P3.mainline_rule: Does not require independent review after required evidence passes.

prohibitions: downgrade a risk classification to bypass review
create a second Source of Truth
mutate production Supabase outside an authorized release

status_semantics.IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED: Implementation and required evidence are complete, but independent review remains pending or is explicitly deferred to a Work Package gate.
status_semantics.VERIFIED: The immutable implementation commit is supported either by APPROVED independent review or, only for P2/P3, explicit owner fast-track acceptance with passing evidence.
